name: defuddle
tagline_zh: 粘贴乱糟糟的网页链接，它用 Defuddle 把正文抽成干净 Markdown，连广告、弹窗、侧栏一并剔除。
tagline_en: Paste a messy URL, get clean Markdown via Defuddle—ads, popups, sidebars stripped, for articles you saved but.
desc_en: Plan and, with explicit network consent, use an optional external Defuddle cleaner to extract article-like HTTPS pages as Markdown. Use for defuddle, clean this URL, strip page clutter, readable Markdown from a web page, or preparing a web source for later wiki ingestion.
why_zh: 同类工具只给纯文本，它保留标题和结构，且需你明确同意才联网，隐私可控，适合后续喂给 wiki。
why_en: Unlike plain-text extractors, it keeps headings and structure, and only goes online with your explicit consent—perfect for wiki.
